limitations: The match is spatial and year-based; CFSDS and BC source incident identifiers are not directly linked in the query, so treat it as a strong candidate crosswalk pending a shared-key or chronology check.
These are historical perimeter records captured after each target day. They are used only for incident identification and are not valid pre-target simulator inputs.
Fire size, cause and fire date do not reveal the suppression actions, staffing or daily resource schedule.
No other train, validation or test events were examined.
